the-css-box-model.label: The CSS Box Model
the-css-box-model.summary: Use the inherited portfolio to see how content, padding, border, and margin create the space every element occupies.

sketch0.title: Every visible element is a box

sketch1.title: A border makes the box edge visible

try_the_css_box_model_sketch0.title: Try it yourself: Add inner space to the main content box
try_the_css_box_model_sketch0.prompt:
**Problem**

The portfolio's main content sits too close to its own edges, so the page feels cramped even though the structure is correct.

**Task**

Keep the complete previous stylesheet and add `main { padding: 1.5rem; }`.

try_the_css_box_model_sketch1.title: Try it yourself: Reveal section box edges with a border
try_the_css_box_model_sketch1.prompt:
**Problem**

The page has semantic sections, but their box boundaries are invisible, making it harder to see where one content region ends and another begins.

**Task**

Keep all previous CSS and add `section { border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; }`.

try_the_css_box_model_sketch2.title: Try it yourself: Separate the footer with outside space
try_the_css_box_model_sketch2.prompt:
**Problem**

The footer begins too close to the content above it, so the end of the page does not feel visually separated.

**Task**

Keep the cumulative stylesheet and add `footer { margin-top: 2rem; }`.

the-css-box-model-single-1.title: Check the first box-model decision
the-css-box-model-single-1.prompt: Which box-model layer sits directly around the content before the border?
the-css-box-model-single-1.hint: Choose the property or layer whose location matches the question.

help.concept: Use the box-model concept named in the lesson rather than guessing from visual appearance alone.
help.hint_1: Compare what happens inside the border with what happens outside it.
help.hint_2: Choose the option that matches the exact CSS responsibility described.

the-css-box-model-multi-2.title: Recognize what margin does
the-css-box-model-multi-2.prompt: Which statements correctly describe CSS margin?
the-css-box-model-multi-2.hint: Evaluate each statement independently against the lesson. More than one choice may be correct.

help.concept: A multi-select can have several correct statements.
help.hint_1: Check each statement independently against the prompt.
help.hint_2: Select every statement that is fully correct and leave the others unselected.

try-the-css-box-model-sketch1.title: Reveal section box edges with a border
try-the-css-box-model-sketch1.prompt:
**Problem**

The page has semantic sections, but their box boundaries are invisible, making it harder to see where one content region ends and another begins.

**Task**

Keep all previous CSS and add `section { border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; }`.
try-the-css-box-model-sketch1.hint: Style the existing section boxes directly.

help.concept: A `border` makes the box boundary visible, which helps you see exactly where later `padding` and `margin` act.
help.hint_1: Style the existing section boxes directly.
help.hint_2: Check pages with sections: each existing section should gain a subtle `outline` without adding any wrapper HTML.

try-the-css-box-model-sketch2.title: Separate the footer with outside space
try-the-css-box-model-sketch2.prompt:
**Problem**

The footer begins too close to the content above it, so the end of the page does not feel visually separated.

**Task**

Keep the cumulative stylesheet and add `footer { margin-top: 2rem; }`.
try-the-css-box-model-sketch2.hint: Choose the spacing property that lives outside the element's `border`.

help.concept: Margin creates separation outside the footer box, unlike `padding` which would only add space inside it.
help.hint_1: Choose the spacing property that lives outside the element's `border`.
help.hint_2: Preview the bottom of several pages: there should be a clear `gap` before the footer while the footer's internal size stays the same.
